semanticScope: AH-03 internal API host outcome routing only. Immutable XSLT REC https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-xslt-30-20170608/ sections 2.3.2-2.3.4 and 2.9 remain the invocation/error context; this step changes host-owned lifetime/error reporting, not language semantics.
hostPolicy: Bind the structured raw source report to the exact engine-issued executable/binding/session. Malformed membership/closed/canceled raw admission is reported without entering producers. After completion, check engine session/snapshot lifetime only; preserve original work/cleanup error identities and keep an existing work error instead of replacing it with a delivery failure.
stagingPolicy: Internal reference-type capture staging retains one already-produced detached diagnostic object if final frame/raw/delivery guards refuse. The staging callback is engine-only, accepts one non-null result during the producer callback, cannot survive that callback, and a normally returned result must be the same reference. Staging does not certify detachment, grant graph authority or convert failure to success; the future serializer/capture layer must supply actual detached data.
exclusions: No public generic callback/outcome API, no public XSLT types, serializer/control-gate changes, provider members or owner/native/budget/freeze/package/publication acceptance. Ordinary Run/RunAsync and public XQuery behavior remain unchanged.
